from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import ast, copy, hashlib, json, runpy, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
root = Path.cwd()
stage = root / "tasks/portal-background-session-20261019/evidence/active-cutoff-fix-20261024"
helper, validator_path = stage / "compare-results.py", stage / "validate-implementation.py"
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
load = lambda path: json.loads(path.read_text())
inventory = load(stage / "case-inventory.json")
cases = {case["id"]: case for case in inventory["cases"]}
template_case = cases["E2E-04"]
template_result_path = stage / template_case["candidate_result"]["path"]
template_result = load(template_result_path)
template_run = load(stage / template_case["candidate_run"]["path"])
protected = [root / ".workbench/session-active-cutoff-fix-20261024/sessionRenewal.original.cjs"]
for subtree in ["browser", "counterfactual/browser"]:
    protected.extend(path for path in (stage / subtree).rglob("*") if path.is_file())
protected.extend(root / "repos/ui/mfe-base" / name for name in [
    "src/pages/Home/common/useController.ts", "src/pages/Home/common/sessionRefresh.test.tsx",
    "src/pages/Home/common/sessionLifecycle.test.tsx"])
before = {str(path.relative_to(root)): sha(path) for path in protected}
rows = []
scenarios = [
    ("E2E-15", "hidden-state-timeout", False, "EXECUTION_ERROR", False),
    ("E2E-15", "visible-state-timeout", True, "EXECUTION_ERROR", False),
    ("E2E-19", "acquire-refresh-hidden-timeout", False, "EXECUTION_ERROR", False),
    ("E2E-21", "isolated-subject-hidden-timeout", False, "EXECUTION_ERROR", False),
    ("E2E-16", "token-install-timeout", False, "FAILED", True),
    ("E2E-16", "unknown-wait-site", False, "FAILED", None),
]
for case_id, scenario, hidden_observed, expected_outcome, expected_eligible in scenarios:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="visibility-setup-probe-") as temporary:
        trial = Path(temporary).resolve()
        fixture = trial / "source/native/probe"
        artifacts = fixture / "artifacts"
        artifacts.mkdir(parents=True)
        original = cases[case_id]
        raw = copy.deepcopy(template_result)
        raw.update(caseId=original["case_id"], status="FAILED",
                   error="page.waitForFunction: Timeout 10000ms exceeded.")
        raw["refresh"] = None
        raw["lifecycle"]["events"] = [{"event": "pageshow", "visibility": "visible",
                                     "timestamp": raw["startedAt"]}]
        if hidden_observed:
            raw["lifecycle"]["events"].append({"event": "visibilitychange", "visibility": "hidden",
                                               "timestamp": raw["startedAt"]})
        run = copy.deepcopy(template_run)
        run.update(mode=original["mode"], status="FAILED", error=raw["error"])
        raw_path, run_path = artifacts / "result.json", fixture / "run.json"
        raw_path.write_text(json.dumps(raw, indent=2) + "\n")
        run_path.write_text(json.dumps(run, indent=2) + "\n")
        for screenshot in raw["screenshots"]:
            shutil.copyfile(template_result_path.parent / screenshot["file"], artifacts / screenshot["file"])
        case = {key: copy.deepcopy(value) for key, value in original.items()
                if not key.startswith("candidate_")
                and key not in {"transition", "comparison_valid", "evidence_validity", "reason_code",
                                "validity_basis", "validity_source"}}
        for key in ["prior_run", "prior_result"]:
            case[key]["path"] = str((stage / case[key]["path"]).resolve())
        (trial / "case-inventory.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "cases": [case], "total_cases": 1, "baseline_counts": {"FAILED": 1}}))
        (trial / "progress.json").write_text("{}\n")
        input_hash = sha(raw_path)
        command = [sys.executable, "-B", str(helper), "--record", case_id,
                   "--run", str(run_path), "--result", str(raw_path), "--evidence-root", str(trial)]
        completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
        assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr
        selected = load(trial / "case-inventory.json")["cases"][0]
        validator = runpy.run_path(str(validator_path))
        validator["case_eligibility"].__globals__["STAGE"] = trial
        eligibility = validator["case_eligibility"](selected)
        direct = validator["classify"](case_id, raw["status"], raw)
        assert selected["candidate_business_outcome"] == expected_outcome == direct
        assert sha(raw_path) == input_hash == sha(trial / selected["candidate_result"]["path"])
        marker_rejection = None
        if expected_eligible is False:
            assert selected["comparison_valid"] is False
            assert selected["evidence_validity"] == "INVALID_COMPARISON"
            assert selected["reason_code"] == "NATIVE_VISIBILITY_PRECONDITION_FAILED"
            assert not eligibility["eligible"]
            misleading = copy.deepcopy(selected)
            misleading.update(candidate_business_outcome="FAILED", comparison_valid=True, evidence_validity="VALID")
            misleading["candidate_attempts"][-1].update(
                business_outcome="FAILED", comparison_valid=True, evidence_validity="VALID")
            marker_rejection = validator["case_eligibility"](misleading)
            assert not marker_rejection["eligible"]
        elif expected_eligible is True:
            assert eligibility["eligible"]
        rows.append({
            "case_id": case_id, "scenario": scenario, "status": "PASSED",
            "synthetic_raw_error": raw["error"], "hidden_event_in_top_level_lifecycle": hidden_observed,
            "expected_outcome": expected_outcome, "helper_outcome": selected["candidate_business_outcome"],
            "comparison_valid": selected["comparison_valid"], "evidence_validity": selected["evidence_validity"],
            "reason_code": selected["reason_code"], "validity_basis": selected["validity_basis"],
            "validator_direct_classification": direct,
            "validator_eligible": eligibility["eligible"] if expected_eligible is not None else None,
            "misleading_valid_markers_rejected": marker_rejection,
            "wait_site_proven_by_raw_result": False if expected_eligible is None else "Synthetic scenario definition only.",
            "unknown_site_limit": ("No setup or business cause is established for an unknown E2E-16 wait site. "
                                   "This probe verifies only that no blanket visibility guard was added."
                                   if expected_eligible is None else None),
            "temporary_cli": command, "exit_code": completed.returncode,
            "stderr": completed.stderr, "temporary_fixture_removed_on_exit": True,
            "temporary_raw_and_retained_hashes_equal": True,
        })
for path in [helper, validator_path]:
    ast.parse(path.read_text())
after = {str(path.relative_to(root)): sha(path) for path in protected}
assert before == after
print(json.dumps({
    "recorded_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "status": "PASSED", "cases": rows,
    "syntax": [{"path": path.name, "sha256": sha(path), "status": "PASSED"}
               for path in [helper, validator_path]],
    "preservation": {"file_count": len(before), "before_equals_after": True,
                     "before_manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(before, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
                     "after_manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(after, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
                     "scope": "Existing raw browser artifacts, original assertion module, and three application files.",
                     "inventories_and_progress": "The probe never writes live inventories or progress. An independent browser queue can update them."},
    "business_execution_performed": False,
}, indent=2))
